title: Extend Foreign Slices
goal: Implement an extension trait for slices using method chaining.
hints: Start by defining the method signature of ends inside the trait implementation.
Extract the first element before using it to fallback for single-element slices.
explanation: To add methods to foreign types like `[T]`, you declare an extension trait and implement it for `[T]`. The second block relies on `f` defined in the previous block, ensuring a strict and valid block order.
